verify_detail: ot cause:** BenchTarget's `SyncComponent` deliberately simulates a flaky sync dependency by consulting a persisted launch counter and skipping sync (hiding the Retry button) on the 3rd and 5th launch of every 5-launch cycle. The UI test is asserting on a non-deterministic-looking but actually cycle-deterministic piece of app state without resetting or controlling that counter, so results depend entirely on which position in the 5-launch cycle the test happens to land on at the start of the run."
